flag.description: Flag id in the story.*/progress.*/tech.* namespaces.

tableRef.description: For start_encounter: a spawn-table instance id from the #7 system.

actorId.description: NPC id for npc_talk/npc_battle/scripted_beat; null for tiles, items, doors.

eventId.description: Kebab id, stable forever once shipped.

locationId.description: A node id from region1-route-graph.json (#11). Events hang on the graph; they do not invent places.

script.description: Pointer, never embedded text: {source:'dialogue-kit', path, entry} or {source:'ink', path, knot}.

flagId.description: Namespaced: story.* (beats), progress.* (clears), tech.* (techniques ILLUMINATE etc.). vars.* is the only non-boolean namespace and ships nearly empty by design.

description: Native event/flag architecture. Discovery states (#14) and the Fragment count are DERIVED at read time and deliberately have no stored field anywhere in this schema.
